_about: Opus Vector firmware parameters (TtParams, Controllers/core/tt_params.h). The source of record: Tools/gen_params.js turns this into Controllers/core/params_opus_vector.c. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored. Values come from Opus_Car_Spec/sim_mapping.md and calibration.md.
name: opus_vector
_mass_eff_kg: m + N*J*gear^2/r^2 = 2.1315 + 2*3.22e-6*11.2^2/0.033^2. J is the simulated per-motor rotor inertia (VehiclePresets.cs); Tools/verify.js checks the pair.
_eta_back: 1/0.85: mirrors the sim, which multiplies by eta when back-driven (BUG-05). Set the measured value when ACT-04 fixes the sim.
_regen_n_per_ms: hobby-ESC shorted-winding brake at the road, whole car: 2*kt^2*gear^2*eta/(R*r^2), R = 0.060 per simulated motor
_regen_max_n: at the ESC's 30 A per motor
_regen_grip_cap_n: MEASURED (run R1): the rear axle unloads under braking and saturates near 9 N
_servo_slew_rad_s: 600 deg/s, for the servo observer only
_cal: MEASURED runs R1/R2, see mission_cfg.h history and Opus_Car_Spec/calibration.md
_odo_lead_comp: sim only: corrects WheelEncoderSensor's left-endpoint integration bias. 0 on the real car; delete with SEN-02.
